item.title: Vacation Cafe Simulator
item.description:
Title: Vacation Cafe Simulator
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Alice Games
Publisher: Alice Games
Release Date: Aug 20, 2026




About This Game

Key Features:

  • Cook Authentic Cuisine: Master traditional Italian recipes through engaging mini-games to prepare pizza, pasta, bruschetta, and more.

  • Develop Your Restaurant: Invest your earnings to buy new equipment, expand your menu, and improve your restaurant's interior and ambiance.

  • Explore the World: Visit nearby shops and locations like wineries and farms to discover new opportunities and add unique touches to your cafe.

  • Serve Your Customers: Take orders, serve meals and drinks, and delight your customers with top-notch service to build a loyal following.

  • Immersive Experience: Combine management skills, culinary mastery, and the zest of exploration to build your dream gastronomic business.

Embark on a flavorful journey and turn your vacation cafe into the most beloved spot in town!

Step into the shoes of an Italian vacation cafe owner and craft the ultimate dining experience! In ‘ Vacation Cafe Simulator ,’ you'll manage a cozy restaurant, cook delicious Italian dishes, and serve your guests while immersing yourself in the authentic atmosphere of Italy.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

We used AI to generate initial music tracks, concept art, and temporary translations into some languages.
All materials were then thoroughly edited, reworked, and finalized by humans.
Nothing went straight from the generator into the game.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 10 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 15 GB available space

item.title: Brigador Killers
item.description:
Title: Brigador Killers
Genre: Action , Indie , Early Access
Developer: Stellar Jockeys , Gausswerks
Publisher: Stellar Jockeys
Franchise: Brigador
Release Date: Aug 20, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Aug 20, 2026




About This Game

Isometric insurgent simulator. Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga.

You are a member of Team Anchor, deployed to the SNC homeworld to make them pay for what they did.

Get around Mar Nosso on foot, or go loud against local forces with your own armor.

Acquire and fire 30+ firearms, from Nossian Corvid zipguns to the latest in man-portable Spacer tech.

  • Upgrade your arsenal by finding different combat rigs.

  • Salvage vehicles for parts to fabricate new tools of destruction in your base.

  • Mount weapons to your new creations and deploy with them .

  • Drive around rich detailed sprite environments in vehicles like clapped-out sedans, tanks or bipedal mechs.

  • Listen to an original soundtrack scored by acclaimed musician Makeup And Vanity Set .

  • Disrupt the corporate control of Mar Nosso by killing Brigadors .

Brigador Killers is in active development and coming to a Steam store near you.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Players can cause destruction across numerous levels both on foot and in a vehicle. Combat is with both hostile NPCs and vehicles, though both hostile and non-hostile human-scale characters can be attacked and subsequently gibbed by the player, leaving blood spats.

In-game text entries may not be fit for those under the age of 16, as some contain descriptions of violent acts, crude humor and horror.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: 2.6 GHz or faster
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD Radeon 5770 / NVIDIA GTX 460 or better
    • Storage: 4 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Best played on mouse and keyboard.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

item.title: Feed the Scorchpot
item.description:
Title: Feed the Scorchpot
Genre: Indie , Strategy
Developer: Moravian
Publisher: Indieformer , WhisperGames
Release Date: Aug 20, 2026




About This Game

You struck a deal with a dragon: twenty years of protection for twenty years of dinner service. The island thrives under the beast's watchful eye, as long as the meals keep coming.

Every year, the dragon wakes up hungrier . You roll dice to work your island, harvest ingredients, fuse them into recipes, and cook them down in the Scorchpot — the pot you keep full or end up in. Get the meal right and you prosper . Get it wrong and you're smoke.

Build farmsteads, shrines, and harbors across your hex-grid island, each one changing how the board pays out. The best runs start with a handful of tiles and end with a machine that buries the dragon in food. Then the odds tighten, the dragon turns picky, and you tear the whole thing down and rebuild while it's on fire.

Feed the Scorchpot , keep the dragon happy, and outlast the contract.

  • Build a scoring engine — Place farms, shrines, and harbors so they feed each other. 50+ buildings and 80+ recipes to mix and upgrade, until a handful of tiles becomes board-breaking numbers.

  • Every meal is a math puzzle — Combine ingredients into recipes that boost Flavor and Essence, multiplying your Fodder score into absurd, screen-shaking numbers.

  • Press your luck — Win in fewer seasons for a bigger payoff, but each year you stay raises the stakes: harsher odds, hungrier dragons, the odd tantrum that torches your board.

  • Build your dice — 20+ types: odd, even, colored, even dice carved into six sixes. Tune your tray and pray the dragon's merciful.

  • Broken combos, on purpose — Bend the rules, break the math, and rebuild when everything catches fire.

  • Hand-drawn, every inch — Every dragon, building, and meal drawn by Daniela, the artist half of the married duo who made the game.

  • For combo addicts — If you've broken Balatro or Slay the Spire wide open with one overpowered synergy, you'll feel at home.

  • Quick to pick up — Roll, cook, feed: you've got the loop by your first year. Staying ahead of the dragon for twenty is the hard part.

  • Cozy on top, ruthless underneath — Hand-drawn and warm, right up until the fire catches.

    Cook cleverly, plan badly, or just roll with it — the dragon doesn't care how you win, only that you feed the beast on time. And yes, you can pet the dragon.

Descrierea conținutului pentru adulți indisponibilă.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS *: Win 7 or later
    • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
    • Memory: 2 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better
    • Storage: 700 MB available space
* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.

item.title: KOTAMON: My Sis Found A Super-Rare Card In Her Cereal Box, So I Became A Garbage Man To Find The Entire Collection And Earn $1,000,000
item.description:
Title: KOTAMON: My Sis Found A Super-Rare Card In Her Cereal Box, So I Became A Garbage Man To Find The Entire Collection And Earn $1,000,000
Genre: Indie , Simulation
Developer: KotaMota Games
Publisher: Polnoch
Release Date: Aug 20, 2026




About This Game

A fun, laid-back game

No one will rush you, or watch your every step, or criticize your actions. You can meditatively sift through garbage looking for interesting things... or just run around with a trash bag! Your dump site, your rules!

Find 'em all!

There are dozens of unique cards with hand-drawn illustrations by the world's best artists!* Collect sets of different colors to earn rewards. If you're lucky, you'll find an unopened cereal box with a super-rare foil card inside!

------

*According to the artists themselves

Mend and swap cards!

A dump site is not a good place to store cards. Often, you'll be find cards that are crumpled, damaged... or torn into pieces even. Don't worry; you can mend them or swap them for better ones! The better the card's condition, the more expensive it is!

Hidden treasures

In addition to collectible cards, you can find lots of interesting things at the dump site that were thrown away by mistake or by accident. The site owner will pay you well for each such find!

Garbage makes you better

Upgrade yourself to become better, faster, stronger, and more efficient at clearing tons of garbage. Turn yourself into a veritable trash-mowing machine!

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Some illustrations for the trading cards depict characters in revealing clothing, tight clothing, and/or sexual poses, without full nudity, nipples, or genitals. There are no sexual scenes or suggestive content in the game.

All characters in the game are adults.

You can (voluntarily) drink beer in the game.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i3 or analogue
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce 960 4gb VRAM or analogue
    • Storage: 3 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel Core i7 or analogue
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce 1070 Ti or analogue
    • Storage: 5 GB available space

item.title: How to Fish
item.description:
Title: How to Fish
Genre: Action , Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Dazed Games
Publisher: Dazed Games
Release Date: Aug 20, 2026




About This Game

A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

Here is a gif:

What you do in the game:

  • Fish fish, kill fish, sell fish

  • Start off with no gear or weapons, earn money to buy better gear and weapons and stuff

  • Complete quests and fight bosses to progress to new islands, where there are more dangerous creatures and better gear

  • Try to collect the rare variant of all the different fish

  • Hit trick shots for more money

  • Gamble for even more money

The developers describe the content like this:

This game includes cartoon violence towards fish and gambling with fish (no real money)

    • Processor: Intel Core i5-5257U, AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent

    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050, AMD RX 460 or equivalent
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 1 GB available space
